properties.description: Amélie (Le Fabuleux Destin d'Amélie Poulain) is a 2001 romantic comedy directed by Jean-Pierre Jeunet, with a US release on 2002-02-08. Starring Audrey Tautou, Mathieu Kassovitz, and Rufus, the film follows a shy, imaginative Parisian waitress who secretly engineers small acts of kindness that ripple through her neighborhood. Stylistically distinctive and narratively character-driven, it blends whimsical visual flourishes with themes of loneliness, connection, and the search for love, producing a warm, bittersweet emotional tone.

short_descriptions.value: A shy, imaginative Parisian waitress secretly engineers small acts of kindness to help others and, in the process, seeks connection and true love.
Eine phantasievolle Pariser Kellnerin arrangiert kleine Freundlichkeiten, um anderen zu helfen, und sucht dabei Verbindung und wahre Liebe.
Una camarera parisina imaginativa organiza pequeñas bondades para ayudar a los demás y, en el proceso, busca la conexión y el amor verdadero.
Une serveuse parisienne imaginative organise de petites bonnes actions pour aider les autres et, ce faisant, cherche la connexion et l'amour véritable.
